summary: First full test pass for NSUT Hub. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass against public URL (health, vacant-rooms default + ?slot=3, slot indexing, news, results scrape for 2023UCS1234 returns 200 + ok:true, profile upsert+GET persistence, attendance upsert+GET persistence, null returns for missing rolls). Frontend (390x844): login-root renders, Skip-for-now lands on home-root with 'Not synced yet' attendance card, live strip showing room count, all 4 quick action tiles (rooms/attendance/results/news) render and navigate correctly. Rooms screen shows weekday+IST time, count badge, 10 slot chips, block-grouped list; Saturday run surfaced the weekend banner and all 36 rooms free. Attendance tab shows filter chips (all/theory/practical) + empty-sync CTA that routes to /login for guest. More tab shows Guest profile card and all 4 rows navigate (results, news, resync->/login, logout clears storage and returns to /login). Results screen (guest) shows roll input + lookup button; entering 2023UCS1234 renders results-cgpa-card with real CGPA data. News screen renders hero + 'Trending\nSoon.' text and both news-back / news-back-home work. No red screen, no console errors; one deprecation warning only (TouchableWithoutFeedback in login.tsx).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning on web console: 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:12 (and :69 usage wrapping ScrollView for keyboard dismiss). Replace with Pressable to future-proof.

action_items: Low priority: Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback in app/login.tsx with Pressable (or a keyboard-dismiss View) to silence RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py vacant-rooms: IST conversion builds a datetime from UTC year/month/day with IST hour/minute; this is incorrect across date boundaries (e.g. late UTC evening maps to next-day IST, but weekday still uses UTC date). Low impact in practice but worth switching to zoneinfo('Asia/Kolkata').
server.py results endpoint: scrape returns ok:false silently on exceptions — fine for UX, but logger.exception would help debugging; also no caching so each call hits resulthubnsut.com.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers.
api_router.get('/profile/{roll_number}', response_model=Optional[...]) returning None works but is unconventional — a 404 would be more RESTful.
seed_data_creation: Each test run inserts TEST_<uuid> prefixed profile + attendance docs in Mongo. Minor cleanup not required (prefixed, non-colliding).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://nsut-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Guest flow: tap [data-testid=skip-button] on /login → lands on /(tabs) home. ResultHub scrape for 2023UCS1234 currently returns ok:true with a CGPA value; tests therefore accept either ok:true or ok:false. Vacant-rooms total is 36 (not 35). IMS WebView is native-only — not tested here.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. One deprecation warning (TouchableWithoutFeedback) addressed in action_items.
